title: 📅 Calendrier boursier 2025 - FranceTransactions.com
content: The article lists the 2025 stock‑market closure calendar for France and other major European and U.S. exchanges. According to the article, the Paris Bourse will be closed on six dates: 1 January 2025 (New Year), 21 April 2025 (Easter Monday), 18 April 2025 (Good Friday), 1 May 2025 (Labour Day), 25 December 2025 (Christmas) and 26 December 2025 (Boxing Day). It notes that the market will also close early after 14:00 on 24 December and 31 December. The article states that the Paris schedule is mirrored by Amsterdam, Brussels and Lisbon, while Dublin adds 6 May, Milan adds 15 August and 24 December, and Oslo adds five extra holidays including 24 December. In the United States, the article reports ten market‑closure days in 2024, with New York’s NYSE closed on 1 January, 15 January, 19 February, 29 March, 27 May, 19 June, 4 July, 2 September, 28 November and 25 December. The piece also explains the Service à Règlement Différé (SRD), a short‑sale buying service that allows trading without owning the shares, and lists promotional offers such as waived brokerage fees for 100 orders between 500 € and 10 000 €, up to 20 free shares, and up to 200 € in bonuses. The article is purely informational, presenting dates and facts without editorial commentary.

title: 和讯投顾潘榕榕：可依据尾盘行情，判断次日股价走势-新闻频道-和讯网
content: According to Pan Rongrong, a consultant at Hexun, the closing price of a stock can be used to predict the next day's price trend. If the stock price is volatile throughout the day and then rises at the end of the trading day, it indicates that the main force has been observing the market all day and is building up positions at the end of the day, which means the stock price is likely to rise sharply the next day. If the stock price suddenly drops at the end of the trading day and forms a long upper shadow, it suggests that the main force is performing regular operations, and the stock price is likely to rise in the next few trading days. If the stock price breaks through at the end of the trading day and is in a state of consolidation, with a large increase in trading volume, it indicates that the main force has completed its position-building and the stock price is likely to rise significantly. If the stock price is volatile throughout the day and then reverses and rises above the trend line at the end of the trading day, it suggests that the main force is building up positions. Pan Rongrong said, 'These are the four possible scenarios that can be used to predict the next day's price trend based on the closing price.'

title: Stock market holiday: Is US stock market closed or open today for Labor Day 2025? | Stock Market News
content: The United States stock markets will remain closed on Monday, 1 September 2025, in observance of Labor Day, according to the official holiday list of the Nasdaq Stock Exchange and the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE). Because the market is closed on Saturday and Sunday, there is no half‑day trading session preceding the holiday. Official NYSE data indicates that only two other holidays will occur in 2025: Thanksgiving on 27 November and Christmas on 25 December. title: August 2025 Results - The Wrap - FNArena.com
content: The August 2025 results season is described as a period of subdued earnings and moderate guidance, yet it was also marked by a persistent positive momentum that followed the April sell‑off.  The article notes a tension between the market’s upbeat performance and concerns that investors are overlooking fundamentals.  By the end of August, the ASX200 was trading at a 19‑times multiple of next year’s consensus earnings forecast, a level usually reserved for U.S. equities, which has sparked the social‑media debate ‘when the correction?’ The piece highlights that the impact of AI remains largely speculative, especially for companies such as Goodman Group (GMG) and NextDC (NXT), and that the market’s polarization continues without clear answers.  The author questions whether the market can sustain new highs without solid earnings growth, underscoring the uncertainty surrounding the Australian equity market.
